notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Russian and French!
notes.content:
Hey! We're here with the first update, mostly bug fixes and UX:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28231466/f99a9a794d0954fb9d5369d9287dc0fa4a7011cf.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28231466/a6803f23f604a5e43117aa77a697a3221a1b7e20.png[/img]

ARCADE:
[list]
[*] Moles no longer become invincible a few frames late
[*] Time requirements for challenge more humanly possible
[*] New achievements for the toughest challenges
[/list]

VERSUS:
[list]
[*] Grafitti time can now be set on seconds jumping in intervals of 15s
[*] Countdown adjusts better to Extra Rules involving game speed
[*] Changed blinking timing of score counter tvs so they are more easily readable
[*] Added and polished sound for Extra Rules
[/list]

OTHER:
[list]
[*] Fixed "Previously on rumpus" sign size
[*] Corrected a few issues with the French translation
[*] Added Russian localization (thanks to @CharmyCthulhu!)
[*] Mouse cursor now hides on fullscreen
[*] Small text fixes
[*] Fixed aligment of hint beneath arcade level preview
[*] Reduced and refined quality settings
[*] Fixed misc performance issues
[/list]
